data.title: [Meeting You in the World o'Shrooms] Version Pre-Download & Update Notice
data.brief:
Dear Endministrator, 
Pre-download for the [Meeting You in the World o'Shrooms] version of Arknights
data.data:
Dear Endministrator, 
Pre-download for the [Meeting You in the World o'Shrooms] version of Arknights: Endfield is now available. You can pre-download some of the game resources on your PC, mobile device, and PlayStation®5 to get into the game faster once the update and maintenance are complete. 
Additionally, we plan to begin maintenance for the game client version update on Nov. 25, 2026 at 06:00 (UTC+8). After maintenance is complete, the game will be updated to the new version [Meeting You in the World o'Shrooms]. 
This update is mandatory. You will not be able to log into the game during the maintenance period; please plan your gaming schedule accordingly. Once the update is complete, you will need to re-download the game client. Due to the large download size, we recommend that you download the update using a stable Wi-Fi connection. 

▼// Pre-Download Guide 
■ PC 
Open GRYPHLINK. The [Pre-Download] icon will appear to the left of the [Play] button. Click the icon to begin downloading. The pre-download size is approximately 7GB. 

■ Mobile (Android & iOS) 
Open the game, and find the [Pre-Download Resources] icon on the login screen. Tap the icon to begin downloading. The pre-download size is approximately 4GB. 
※ Mobile pre-download will end on Nov. 25, 2026 at 05:30 (UTC+8). While pre-downloading, you will not be able to play the game. Please plan your pre-download time accordingly. 

■ PlayStation®5 
· Go to the home screen, select [Arknights: Endfield], press the controller's [OPTIONS] button, select [Check for Update] to begin downloading. The pre-download size is approximately 55GB. 

▼// Version Maintenance Time 
Asia Server: Nov. 25, 2026 at 06:00 – Nov. 25, 2026 at 12:00 (UTC+8) 
Americas / Europe Server: Nov. 24, 2026 at 17:00 – Nov. 24, 2026 at 23:00 (UTC-5)

▼// New Version Guide 
The New Version Guide Page has been updated with the key content and information for the [Meeting You in the World o'Shrooms] version. Browse the page and click [Claim Rewards] before Nov. 25, 2026 at 06:00 (UTC+8) to claim [Oroberyl]×1000, [T-Creds]×10000, [Elementary Cognitive Carrier]×8, and [Arms INSP Set]×4. 
>>Click to Go: https://endfield.gryphline.com/version_briefing/latest?source_from=official

▼// How to Update 
After maintenance for the version update begins, you can follow the in-game instructions to proceed with the update. 
· PC: After closing the game, restart GRYPHLINK and click [Update]. 
· Android: Enter the game and follow the pop-up prompts to complete the update. 
· iOS: Enter the App Store and tap [Update]. 
· PlayStation®5: Go to the home screen, select [Arknights: Endfield], press the controller's [OPTIONS] button, select [Check for Update], and confirm the update. 

▼// Update & Maintenance Compensation 
· Compensation Details: [Oroberyl]×900 
· Distribution Period: After the update and maintenance – Before the next version update and maintenance 
· Eligibility: Create a character before the update 
· Note: Update & Maintenance Compensation will be sent via in-game mail. The mail will expire during the next version update and maintenance, so please claim it in time. 

▼// Update & Maintenance Details 
This update is mandatory. You will not be able to log into the game during the maintenance period; please plan your gaming schedule accordingly. Once the update is complete, you will need to re-download the game client. Due to the large download size, we recommend that you download the update using a stable Wi-Fi connection. If your device has completed or started the pre-download, the amount of data you need to download after maintenance will be reduced based on the resources already downloaded, saving time during this stage of the update. The estimated storage space required for this update is as follows. 
· PC: 7GB (An additional 11GB of free storage is required when extracting files. Install the game on an SSD for better gaming experiences.) 
· Android: 4GB (An additional 4GB of free storage is required when extracting files) 
· iOS: 4GB (An additional 4GB of free storage is required when extracting files) 
· PlayStation®5: 55GB (An additional 60GB of free storage is required when extracting files) 
※ Extra storage used during extraction will be freed once the extraction is complete.
